title: You opened the app to check one thing. That was 40 minutes ago.

copy.instagram_caption:
You opened the app to check one thing. That was 40 minutes ago.

If you feel a little wired now, that's not on you. Feeds are built to hold your attention. The tight jaw and short breath are the bill.

DeRot meets you mid-scroll. It pauses your apps while you reset with a few calming breaths, then lets you get back to it, calmer.

Coming soon to iPhone. Launch list: link in bio.
